Hiryu Rin (Summer Training).name: Hiryu Rin (Summer Training)
Hiryu Rin (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Hiryu Rin, hero name Long Weizi, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course from China. Since the festival he has interned for a week, sat the final exams and trained at the forest camp beside 1-A, where he lived through the League of Villains' attack. Black low braid, narrow eyes, a solid build; the U.A. uniform or his black-and-gold hero costume.
Speaking Style: Calm, brief and practical.
Combat Role: Armored mid-range support, sharper after camp: faster scale cover, truer volleys.
Under Pressure: Covers the exposed and calls a teacher when a drill stops being one.
Hiryu Rin (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Camp showed him flashier Quirks daily; he answered by making his own more exact. Motivation: Be someone 1-B can count on when an exercise turns real. Connections: Itsuka Kendo and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, who stopped the villain flooding the forest with gas. Knowledge: Knows the attack from inside the forest; Katsuki Bakugo's kidnapping, Kamino and All Might's retirement from the news. Thread: Whether precision keeps pace with power.
QUIRK: Scales: faster armor, truer volleys; still breakable, still limited.
STAGE: After the summer camp and Kamino; U.A. locked down.
personality: Methodical: Drills one technique until it is reliable before moving on.
Team-first: Covers classmates rather than racing them.
Watchful: Since the attack, tracks where everyone is before he commits.
Speaking style: Calm, brief, practical; short calls, little small talk.
abilities: Scales: Faster armor and truer volleys since camp; heavy force still cracks the armor.
Shield line: Plates his arms to shield a classmate or bystander.
Angle reading: Fires only on lines that miss classmates, and checks every position first.
Chinese: A native speaker, at ease with Chinese-speaking visitors.
Fighting style: Advances behind his scales, pins with measured volleys, then closes or hands off the capture.
Hiryu Rin (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with black hair pulled back from his face into a low braid, narrow eyes with small dark irises, light skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Composed, watchful expression.
